name: Rest-Assured-Allure

on:
  schedule:
    # Todos os dias às 09:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 9 * * *'

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  
jobs:

  test:

    name: Executar testes API
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout código
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configurar Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Executar testes Rest Assured
        run: mvn clean test

      - name: Get Allure history
        if: always()
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          ref: allure
          path: allure-history
      
      - name: Listar histórico
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Conteúdo allure-history:"
          ls -R allure-history

      - name: Gerar relatório Allure
        uses: simple-elf/allure-report-action@master
        if: always()
        with:
          allure_results: allure-results/
          allure_history: allure-history
      
      - name: Verificar histórico gerado
        run: |
          echo "=== Novo history-trend ==="
          cat allure-history/history/history-trend.json || true
      
      - name: Listar history gerado
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Conteúdo history:"
          ls -R allure-history/history

      - name: Verificar histórico baixado
        run: |
          echo "=== history ==="
          ls -R allure-history/history || true

          echo "=== history-trend ==="
          cat allure-history/history/history-trend.json || true

      - name: Publicar relatório Allure
        if: always()
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_branch: allure
          publish_dir: allure-history
